# ninja build file for plan805-probe with iar compiler

# includes
includes = -I../include -I../路径 中文

# defines
defines = -DDEBUG=1 -DVERSION=2

# cflags
cflags = --no_cse --no_unroll --no_inline --no_code_motion --no_tbaa --no_clustering --no_scheduling --debug --endian=little --cpu=Cortex-M4 -e --fpu=VFPv4_sp

# rules
rule as
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/iasmarm.exe -I../include -I../路径 中文 --no_cse --no_unroll --no_inline --no_code_motion --no_tbaa --no_clustering --no_scheduling --debug --endian=little --cpu=Cortex-M4 -e --fpu=VFPv4_sp -o$out $in
    description = Assembling $in

rule cc
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/iccarm.exe -I../include -I../路径 中文 -DDEBUG=1 -DVERSION=2 --no_cse --no_unroll --no_inline --no_code_motion --no_tbaa --no_clustering --no_scheduling --debug --endian=little --cpu=Cortex-M4 -e --fpu=VFPv4_sp --debug -o$out $in
    description = Compiling $in

rule link
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/ilinkarm.exe -o$out $in $ldflags $libs
    description = Linking $out

rule lib
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/iarchive.exe -o$out $in
    description = Building library $out

# build objects for target app
build main.o: cc ../src/main.c
# target executable
build app.exe: link main.o
# build objects for target math
build math.o: cc ../math/math.c
# target library
build math.lib: lib math.o

# build objects for target t
build test.o: cc ../t/test.c
# target executable
build t.exe: link test.o
